summary: regex_replace substitutes text matched by a regex using Python's re.sub, with groups referenced by name or \number.
questions: How do I do a regex search and replace in Ansible?
How do I reference capture groups in regex_replace?

answer_card.title: regex_replace filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ text | regex_replace('pattern', 'replacement') }}` maps to Python's `re.sub`. Reference captured groups in the replacement with `\1` (number) or `\g<name>` (named group).
